summary: Santander UK Group Holdings plc filed a Rule 424(b)(5) prospectus supplement for $2.5 billion of senior unsecured notes: $1.5 billion of 5.314% fixed-to-floating notes due September 15, 2030, and $1.0 billion of 6.046% fixed-to-floating notes due September 15, 2037. Interest is semi-annual until September 2029 and 2036, then quarterly at Compounded SOFR plus 0.995% and 1.589%. Notes rank pari passu, include UK bail-in acknowledgment, and are callable subject to regulatory conditions. This is a routine debt takedown, not a special situation.
